# apim_portal_listing (Resource)

PortalListing Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apim_portal" "developer-portal" {
  hrid = "developer-portal"
  name = "[Terraform] Developer Portal"
  navigation = [
    {
      path         = "/apis"
      display_name = "APIs"
    }
  ]
}

resource "apim_apiv4" "pets" {
  // other properties omitted for simplicity
  hrid = "pets"
  # rest is omitted for simplicity
}

resource "apim_portal_listing" "public-apis" {

  portal_hrid = apim_portal.developer-portal.hrid
  hrid        = "public-apis"
  apis = [
    {
      api_hrid = apim_apiv4.pets.hrid
      location = "/apis"
      order    = 1
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `apis` (Attributes List) List of APIs to publish to the portal. Use each entry's order to control display order relative to siblings at the same location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apis))
- `hrid` (String) A unique human readable id identifying this resource. Requires replacement if changed.
- `portal_hrid` (String) Human-readable ID of a portal

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) environment ID
- `organization_id` (String) organization ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource UUID.

<a id="nestedatt--apis"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apis`

Optional:

- `api_hrid` (String) Human-readable ID of the API to publish. Not Null
- `location` (String) The path in the portal's navigation where this API should appear.
Must match a path defined in the Portal's navigation for the API to be visible.
Not Null
- `order` (Number) Display order of this API relative to its siblings at the same location.
Disambiguates ordering when APIs from multiple listings share a location.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apim_portal_listing.public-apis
  id = jsonencode({
    environment_id  = "DEFAULT"
    hrid            = "public-apis"
    organization_id = "DEFAULT"
    portal_hrid     = "developer-portal"
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apim_portal_listing.public-apis '{"environment_id": "DEFAULT", "hrid": "public-apis", "organization_id": "DEFAULT", "portal_hrid": "developer-portal"}'
```
